quiz.title: Communication Style

intro.title: How should PushApp speak to you?
intro.p1: You'll see 6 short messages, each written in a few different ways. Choose the version you would most like to receive. There are no right or wrong answers.

quiz.questionTitle: Which version would you most like to receive?
quiz.exampleNote: These are example messages. Names and numbers are made up.

direct.title: New friend request
direct.body: Alex sent you a friend request. Review it now.

explanatory.title: A new friend request
explanatory.body: Alex would like to connect with you. Open the request to accept or decline.

warm.title: Someone would like to join you
warm.body: Alex sent you a friend request. Take a look and see if you'd like to connect.

energizing.title: Your circle may be growing
energizing.body: Alex wants to connect. Open the request and choose what feels right.

direct.title: A friend may need support
direct.body: Alex may need support. Send a message.

explanatory.title: A friend may need support
explanatory.body: Alex may benefit from a check-in. You can open their profile and send a message.

warm.title: You could make Alex's day a little easier
warm.body: Alex may need support. A personal message could mean a lot.

energizing.title: Your support can make a difference
energizing.body: Alex may need you today. Send a quick message.

direct.title: 2 Steps remain today
direct.body: Open today's plan and choose your next Step.

explanatory.title: 2 Steps remain in today's plan
explanatory.body: Completing them will finish the plan you set for today. Choose your next Step.

warm.title: You're still moving forward
warm.body: Two Steps are waiting today. We're here when you're ready for the next one.

energizing.title: Two Steps between you and today's plan
energizing.body: Pick the next one and keep your momentum going.

direct.title: Your Streak needs one more Step
direct.body: Complete today's remaining Step to keep your Streak.

explanatory.title: One Step remains to keep your Streak
explanatory.body: Your Streak continues when today's full plan is completed. One Step is still open.

warm.title: Your progress is still yours
warm.body: One Step remains to keep your Streak today. Whatever happens, you can keep moving forward.

energizing.title: Your Streak is within reach
energizing.body: One more Step today. You've still got time to keep it going.

direct.title: Good progress this week
direct.body: You completed 4 of your planned Steps. Keep going.

explanatory.title: You've completed 4 planned Steps
explanatory.body: That is 4 completed Steps toward this week's plan. Review your progress or continue.

warm.title: Look at what you've already done
warm.body: Four planned Steps completed this week. Your effort is showing.

energizing.title: You're building real momentum
energizing.body: Four planned Steps are done this week. Keep it moving.

direct.title: Time for your next Step
direct.body: Your planned Step is ready. Open it now.

explanatory.title: It's time for your planned Step
explanatory.body: This reminder is arriving at the time you chose for this Step. Open it when you're ready.

warm.title: A little reminder for something that matters to you
warm.body: It's time for the Step you planned. We're here when you're ready.

energizing.title: Ready for your next move?
energizing.body: The Step you planned is here. Let's get started.

direct.title: A quick reminder
direct.body: Your next Step is scheduled for now. Open it.

explanatory.title: A scheduled reminder
explanatory.body: You set a reminder for this Step at this time. Open it when it suits you.

warm.title: A gentle nudge
warm.body: The Step you planned is here. No rush, we're with you.

energizing.title: Time to move
energizing.body: Your scheduled Step is ready. Let's go.

tieBreak.title: One more, to help us choose
tieBreak.body: A couple of styles were close. Pick the version you like best.

result.title: Your Communication Style is set to {{style}}
result.hint: You can change this anytime in Settings.

styleDescriptions.direct: PushApp will keep messages short and clear, telling you what matters and what to do next.
styleDescriptions.explanatory: PushApp will add a little context, so you know why a message matters and what it means.
styleDescriptions.warm: PushApp will use a caring, human tone while still telling you clearly what matters.
styleDescriptions.energizing: PushApp will keep an upbeat, encouraging tone that points you to your next move.

settings.title: Communication Style
settings.intro: Choose how PushApp speaks to you. This changes the tone of messages, never what they mean or what you can do.

onboardingEntry.cta: Choose how PushApp speaks to you
